item.title: Biom
item.description: Biom is a visual workspace for material produced by AI agents. An agent writes into a local folder, and Biom presents the results as pages, documents, dashboards, diagrams, tables, boards, forms, or automations that people can inspect and continue editing. The local AGPL-licensed application works with agents that can write files and is free to build and run. Paid collaboration, hosted-agent, sync, web, and mobile plans are listed but were not yet generally available at review time.

item.title: Bulkgrid
item.description: Bulkgrid indexes selected websites and public or private GitHub repositories so AI agents can retrieve current passages with verifiable references. It handles crawling, content processing, change detection, scheduled refreshes, and search access through MCP, a REST API, SDKs, or a CLI. The free plan searches existing public sources with monthly limits; Pro adds source creation, private sources, larger allowances, and configurable refresh schedules.

item.title: Kario
item.description: Kario turns a written brief, product URL, logo, images, or product shots into an animated motion-graphics project. Unlike a flattened generated clip, the result keeps its text, shapes, media, keyframes, and timeline editable. Users can request revisions in plain language, adjust layers manually, connect Claude or ChatGPT through MCP, and export landscape or vertical MP4 files. A free plan includes monthly agent credits, with paid plans adding more credits and higher-resolution exports.

item.title: Threshyr
item.description: Threshyr is a local-first time tracker for Windows and macOS that records active applications, supported browser domains, duration, and idle periods without manual timers. Rules and an on-device model classify activity by project, while focus views and reports summarize productive time and billable work. The pre-release is free without an account or card; the developer lists a future $58 yearly license, with a discounted first year. Firefox and Linux are not currently supported.

item.title: Prmptree
item.description: prmptree is a Gmail-focused AI inbox agent that continuously evaluates messages for urgency, context, relationships, and intent. It can draft replies, flag important mail, archive messages, and propose unsubscribe actions before the user opens the inbox. Adjustable trust settings keep actions available for approval, skipping, or correction so the agent can learn preferences. The official site currently offers free Gmail onboarding and does not publish a paid plan.

item.title: apiweiser-cli
item.description: apiweiser-cli monitors dependency releases, uses an LLM to classify potentially breaking updates, and waits for Renovate to confirm that an upgrade is available. It maps TypeScript call sites, asks a coding agent to build and test a deterministic migration codemod, applies the version and lockfile changes, and opens a pull request for review. Codemods are cached and extended across repositories to reduce repeated work. The public repository is released under the MIT License.

item.title: Pollium
item.description: Pollium turns a topic, syllabus PDF, or whiteboard photo into an editable course roadmap, then creates lessons and skill-based practice. Written answers are graded as evidence of mastery, reviews are spaced over time, and completed courses can issue public certificates. A free monthly token allowance covers core course and practice features; paid plans add formats such as slide decks, podcast episodes, and voice tutoring.
